title: Hardware job that exceeds the 600 second budget
description: User requests a huge shot count. Estimated cost is 5 + 100000 x 0.01 = 1005 s, above the 600 s budget. Phase 1 runs it anyway and the budget goes negative.
user_request: Build a 4-qubit GHZ state. I want very precise statistics, so after the simulator check run it on hardware with 100000 shots.
